data.name: Rusted Hills: Welcome to the Wilderness
data.detailed_description:
Rusted Hills: Welcome to the Wilderness is a single-player and co-op survival sandbox set in a fallen America after an economic collapse and a civil war.

America has fallen. Its cities are silent, its roads are empty, and the wilderness has become a dangerous refuge for the last survivors.

Scavenge ruined places, craft tools, build shelter, manage hunger and thirst, and unlock doors and containers in search of valuable resources. By day, you prepare. By night, everything becomes more dangerous.

Hacked military droids, hostile survivors, bandits, and other threats still roam the land. Avoid them, outsmart them, or fight when there is no other choice.

Survive alone or team up with other players. Build, repair, upgrade, and defend your shelter as you face a broken America one day at a time.

When night comes, every decision matters.

Key Features

Survive Alone or in Co-op
Play solo or team up with other survivors.

Explore a Fallen America
Travel through silent cities, empty roads, ruined locations, hostile military zones, and dangerous settlements.

Scavenge, Craft, and Build
Search for valuable resources, craft useful tools, unlock doors and containers, and build shelter to survive.

Build, Upgrade, and Defend
Create a shelter, repair and upgrade your base, reinforce your defenses, and protect your supplies from the dangers of the wilderness.

Deep Survival Systems
Manage hunger, thirst, weight, health, and status effects while fishing, farming, mining, digging, and cutting wood to gather resources.

Fight or Avoid Danger
Use melee weapons, ranged weapons, projectiles, traps, explosives, and the environment to survive.

Beware of Hacked Military Droids
Deadly machines patrol the land and hunt anything that moves.

Hostile AI and Factions
Face smart enemies, hostile survivors, bandits, and dangerous factions fighting for control of the wilderness.

Quests and Dialogue
Follow objectives, discover stories, and interact through dialogue.

Prepare for the Night
Use daylight to gather resources, reinforce your shelter, and prepare for greater danger after dark.

data.short_description: In Rusted Hills: Welcome to the Wilderness, survival is the only rule. After economic collapse and civil war, America has become a hostile wilderness. Scavenge, build, explore, and prepare. Any night could be your last.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-8700K / AMD® Ryzen™ 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GTX™ 1080 Ti / AMD® Radeon™ RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
